name: sidereus-change
title: 변경 — Sidereus viewer
use: Feature or behaviour change in the Sidereus viewer: criteria, design, parallel implement, verify, review, ship.
rules:
Repo: this repository (the folder holding AGENTS.md). AGENTS.md rules override this prompt.
NEVER restart the viewer, NEVER commit/stash/checkout/reset/add, NEVER run screen_check --update. The orchestrator does those.
Other implementers edit other files in the same tree at the same time: touch only your own files, Edit only on existing files, re-read before each edit.
after: screen-check the live page at 1920/1440/1100/900 (design at 1920; narrower must wrap or collapse, never cram)

stages.title: 요구사항
stages.task: The orchestrator itself writes R1..Rn checkable criteria plus one Non-goal for the request, following the requirements skill; the owner confirms once before 설계 is dispatched. No subagent.

stages.title: 설계
stages.task: Write the spec for the request: summary, rules affected, tests, screen expectations, risk. Put them in summary. Read-only. Consume the request's R1..Rn criteria; each slice names the R ids it covers; tests cite R ids.

stages.title: 구현
stages.task: Implement your slice only. Report the files you changed; put anything outside your slice in findings.

stages.title: 검증
stages.task: Run the gate once and report each failing step as a finding with file/line. Do not fix anything.

stages.title: 리뷰-찾기
stages.task: Find candidate defects in the working-tree diff (git diff + untracked files); follow .claude/review-guide.md. Two reviewers in one message, one lens each: (a) AGENTS.md rules + security (esc, path/arg checks, git_argv, metadata only); (b) logic/behaviour bugs incl. regressions. Every finding = file:line + the rule or failure scenario + a short diff excerpt; style, naming, cleanup and nits are not findings. Report PASS with the candidates; 리뷰-확인 decides. After a loop-back, review only the fix diff. Small change (under ~100 changed lines, no security/metadata path: routes, work.py, MCP, innerHTML, git calls): one reviewer covering both lenses, its FAIL is final, then declare [pl-skip:sidereus-change/리뷰-확인].

stages.title: 리뷰-확인
stages.task: Try to disprove each 리뷰-찾기 finding against the code, git blame and git log -L. Tag survivors Important / Nit / Pre-existing, drop Nits, report only confirmed findings ranked by severity, plus one line per finding: id, rule, verdict (confirmed|disproved|pre-existing). status FAIL only on a confirmed Important introduced by this diff; Pre-existing never blocks.

stages.title: 재검증
stages.task: Run the gate once after the review fix round and report. Do not fix anything.

stages.title: 라이브 검증
stages.task: Report each R line as PASS/FAIL + one piece of evidence (screen crop, test name or file:line).
